notes.title: WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29637924/e38cddd5275d93344bf208c7b6f8826b10dc9878.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Ocean Day!   
[h3]Swim Out is 75% off and we will donate 25% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.*[/h3]
The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025.

[b]Who are WDC?[/b]
WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation are the leading global charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins. 
Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear, pollution, captivity and hunting and whaling. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.
Their mission is to reverse the global decline of whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic beings. And their vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.

[b]What is ghost gear?[/b]
Ghost gear is fishing gear that has been lost or abandoned at sea. It’s a deadly menace to whales, dolphins and other marine life. 
When a whale or dolphin gets tangled in it, it can kill them in the most horrific way, by preventing them from getting to the surface to breathe. Or they can carry it for days, weeks or even months suffering a slow and painful death as it cuts into their skin, restricts their movement and hampers their ability to hunt and feed. 
But it’s difficult and expensive for fishers and other ocean users to dispose of gear they find at sea, or even to responsibly get rid of their own gear at the end of its life.
Did you know that about 1/3 of marine litter found in European seas is discarded fishing gear? That's estimated to be over 11,000 tonnes entering the sea each year!
It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  

[b]How your support will help this year[/b]
By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue their global conservation work, as well as their ghost gear removal project, funding 10 missions for divers to remove lethal entanglement hazards to marine life (and scuba divers) from reefs, seabed and shipwrecks in UK seas.
Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring, intelligent beings. The ocean produces more oxygen and absorbs more carbon than all of Earth's forests combined, and whales help it flourish. Yet 300,000 whales die in fishing gear every year. 
If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: https://whales.org/ 
Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does by signing up to their mailing list here: https://games.whales.org/#newsletter 
And you can find many other amazing games in the sale page!
Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! 

[i]*25% of our net revenue from this sale (after Steam platform fees) will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. WDC is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).[/i]

notes.title: Celebratory Rip Them Off launch sale! 66% off Swim Out, ends Monday!
notes.content:
Hello friends,

We hope each and every one of you is safe, happy and healthy.

Three years ago we launched Swim Out on Steam, and in that time we've been absolutely blown away by the response to our untraditional game, so thank you.

Next week, on Thursday September 24th, we are excited to be launching our new game, Rip Them Off.

[h3]In celebration of this three year milestone, and the launch of Rip Them Off, we are delighted to say that today is the start of a huge 66% off sale on Swim Out! That's right, from now until Monday September 21st at 5pm CEST / 4pm BST / 8am PT, Swim Out is available for 66% off, that's a bargain if we do say so ourselves.[/h3]

[h3]Just click on the top right of this page, or purchase it below: [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/662200/Swim_Out/

We hope those of you who've been interested in Swim Out, but not taken the plunge yet will be convinced by our latest offer. If you do decide to dive into Swim Out with our discount, please remember to leave a review on Steam, it's immensely helpful in getting our game seen by more people. Thank you so much!

[h2]Rip Them Off[/h2]

[h3]If you haven't heard, Rip Them Off is a puzzle game of economic management and tower defense. The Board needs profit, and it’s up to you to line the streets with shops the masses can’t resist. Choose your locations, pick your stores and earn your way up the corporate ladder and its increasingly difficult challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29637924/1cc5f48ea6dc22b4e0750db535f63a5290f956ff.jpg[/img]

Releasing next Thursday September 24th, Rip Them Off has been a labour of love for us and we think you'll really like it. Please, please, please help us to get Rip Them Off into as many hands and in front of as many eyes as possible by Wishlisting it with the button below:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295860/Rip_Them_Off/

We can't wait to hear what you think!

Thank you, as always, and stay safe. 

Ava and Mat x

notes.title: Rip Them Off Beta Test Sign-up is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey friends!

Mat and Ava here from Lozange Lab. In just over a month we're launching our brand new puzzle / tower defense / management game [b]Rip Them Off[/b] on Steam for Windows, Mac, and Linux users. Check out the Steam page here, and please do add it to your [b]Wishlist[/b]: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295860/Rip_Them_Off/ 
We can't wait for our wonderful Swim Out fans to dive into Rip Them Off!

Speaking of which, ahead of our September 24th launch, we need YOUR help. That's right, we're launching a beta test program that'll give you the chance to play Rip Them Off before anyone else, and become an integral part of our development process by providing us with essential feedback on your experience. 

Using your feedback, we'll be able to further balance the game, learn what you love, what you think could be improved, what might be missing from the experience, etc. Your feedback is essential for us to release the absolute best game possible, one that you'll want to play and recommend to your friends.

Excitingly, we're giving selected beta testers the option to have their name credited in the game, as our way of saying thank you for providing us with your wonderful feedback.

The selected players will also be invited to an exclusive Discord server where you'll be able to feedback to us directly (or fill out our feedback form if you'd prefer!). Of course, this means you'll also have the opportunity to ask us any questions that you may have about Rip Them Off, Swim Out, or game development in general.
 
If you are interested in beta testing Rip Them Off, and providing detailed feedback that will help us to improve the game, please be sure to fill out the form linked below:

[b]RIP THEM OFF BETA TEST RECRUITMENT FORM[/b] : https://forms.gle/h77RtgKWe61HKxxy7

[b](NOTE: After submitting your response, Google will likely give you an error message, but we are receiving all of your responses! There's no need to submit twice - thank you)[/b]

Your support is invaluable to indie developers like us here at Lozange Lab, and we would be incredibly grateful if you were to lend us a hand with the final, crucial stage of development of Rip Them Off. We can't wait to get you in the game and experiencing our satirical puzzle / tower defense / management game for yourselves!

Thank you endlessly for your support, and stay safe.

Mat and Ava x

notes.title: Announcing Rip Them Off, coming to Steam (and iOS) on 24th September!
notes.content:
Hello there,

Mat and Ava here, developers of Swim Out. We’d like to share with you our latest project, just announced today! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295860/Rip_Them_Off/]Rip Them Off[/url] is a minimalistic new puzzle game of economic management and tower defense. And don't forget to Rip them Offfff... Oh, you'll have to wait until the 24th of September to invoke your own inner schmuck so until then, don't forget to "Wishlist them all!” and follow us here on Steam. We think that all fans of Swim Out will enjoy this one too!

We’ll keep you posted here and on our socials for updates on Rip Them Off, Swim Out, and all our projects, always eager for your feedback to help us improve the work we do and have a great time with you.

Stay safe,

notes.title: Swim Out is a gorgeous, stylish pool puzzler
notes.content:
As autumn chill sets in I’m really enjoying the sun-bleached holiday pool theme of movement puzzler, Swim Out [official site]! It’s absolutely delightful and puts me in mind of the 1920s, all stylish swim caps and geometry and a south-of-France holiday vibe. I dived in to see if the puzzling side held up and so far so good!

(more…)
